UI_TC09.steps:

2.Go to NAT Policies page, add a NAT policy as follows: FQDN object Original X1 IP X0 range Any Original X1 Any, check Advanced page

UI_TC09.result: The Advanced Settings can't be configured

UI_TC10.steps:
1.Log in FW, add a AO range named "X0 range"
2.Go to NAT Policies page, add a NAT policy as follows:
   Any Original X1 IP X0 range Any Original X1 Any
3.Go to Advanced page, select Round Robin mode, click ADD
4.Re-edit this NAT policy, change Original Source from Any to FQDN object, then check Advanced page
UI_TC10.title: [GUI]Check FQDN is not supported when NAT policy has Advanced configuration
UI_TC10.result: The Advanced Settings became the default mode

Negtive_TC12.steps:
1.Log in FW, add a AO group name "NATgroup" include FQDN objects and normal AOs
2.Go to NAT Policies page, add a NAT policy as follows:
   Original Any NATgroup Original Any Original X1 Any
3.Go to Address Groups page, click the delete icon of the added NAT policy
Negtive_TC12.title: [Negtive]Try to delete an AO Group contains FQDN in use by NAT policies
Negtive_TC12.result: Error message "Error: Object is in use by a NAT Policy" shows

TSR_TC34.steps:
1.Add a domain aaa.com bind to WAN PC IP(visited server) on DNS server(10.8.143.190)
2.Log in FW, config X1 as DHCP mode, add a X1AO within X1 subnet but not X1 IP, change dns server to 10.8.143.190 in Network->DNS page
3.Go to NAT Policies page, add three NAT Policies in FW:
   test1 Any X1 IP aaa.com Original Any Original Any X1
   test2 Any X1AO aaa.com Original Any Original Any X1
   test3 Any Original aaa.com LAN PC IP Any Original X1 Any
4.Download TSR, check info about NAT policies
TSR_TC34.title: [Func]Verify the FQDN based NAT policies information in TSR
TSR_TC34.result: All info about NAT policies show correct in TSR

CLI_TC37.steps:
1.Add a domain aaa.com bind to WAN PC IP(visited server) on DNS server(10.8.143.190)
2.Log in FW, config X1 as DHCP mode, add a X1AO within X1 subnet but not X1 IP, change dns server to 10.8.143.190 in Network->DNS page
3.In CLI, enter the commands as follows, then check NAT Policies page:
   config(18B16989BF80)# nat-policy inbound any outbound X1 source any translated-source X1AO destination aaa.com translated-destination original
CLI_TC37.title: [CLI]Verify FQDN can be added for Original Source/Destination in CLI
CLI_TC37.result: in step3, the nat policy can be added successfully

CLI_TC39.steps:
1.Add a domain aaa.com bind to WAN PC IP(visited server) on DNS server(10.8.143.190)
2.Log in FW, config X1 as DHCP mode, add a X1AO within X1 subnet but not X1 IP, change dns server to 10.8.143.190 in Network->DNS page
3.Go to NAT Policies page, add a NAT Policies in FW:
   test1 Any X1 IP aaa.com Original Any Original Any X1
4.In CLI, enter command "no nat-policy name test1", check NAT Policies page
CLI_TC39.title: [CLI]Verify FQDN can be deleted for Original
CLI_TC39.result: in step4, test1 can be deleted
